purpose: Research-only candidate schema for future explicit charter statuses and authority-bearing designations of registered proof artifacts.
activation_conditions: candidate model and registry are Accepted and Promoted
canonical manifest is created by authorized Repository Change after Promotion
canonical manifest status is Accepted through independent governance
manifest-level acceptance_decision_record resolves and passes structural and digest validation
every registered proof artifact appears exactly once
every artifact_status belongs to the charter taxonomy
every authority-bearing proof artifact has status Accepted
non-authority-bearing artifacts are excluded from active proof authority
all manifest-level and per-artifact decisions include date evidence scope and limitations
all per-artifact status decisions resolve and match manifest artifact status and designation
missing mismatched self-issued non-authoritative hash-invalid or provenance-incomplete decision records block activation
nonclaims: this Research candidate assigns no current artifact status
this Research candidate grants no proof authority
an empty entries list does not satisfy the promotion gate
a future per-entry decision cannot substitute for the manifest's own Acceptance decision
a decision-record string without a resolvable structurally complete and hash-valid record supplies no provenance
this candidate file is not the future canonical manifest
